liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this performance possibly the best Sugaree ever recorded; Reviewer considers this Sugaree one of the best ever performed [27][36]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer identifies Bird Song as another personal favorite version [27]
- **Deal** (1 review): Reviewer highlights the twelve-minute Deal that ended the first set [35]

## The recordings

- **gd83-10-17.sennheiser.skank-levy.347.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 24 songs; 210 min; rated 4.38/5 by 45 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording has a tough, aggressive sound with high energy throughout; Sound quality is incredible, balancing crowd noise with clear band audio [29][32]
- **gd1983-10-17.mtx.seamons.fix2.92424.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 175 min; rated 4.41/5 by 63 [3]
- **gd1983-10-17.fob.senn421.chasingwilma.102070.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 171 min; rated 1/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd83-10-17.sbd.miller.27585.sbeok.flacf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 171 min; rated 4.11/5 by 18 [4]

## Around the show

- Fans formed a hand-holding circle around the upper level during the song [34]
- Jerry displayed a wide, ear-to-ear smile during the opening notes [38]
- Reviewer rates this show higher than the October 14th performance [30]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd83-10-17.sennheiser.skank-levy.347.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB (12th Row) > Sennheiser 421s > WM-D5 (Cassette master) > DAT > CD [1]
- **gd1983-10-17.mtx.seamons.fix2.92424.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See Notes; transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: See Notes [3]. Also: Matrix mix combines two SBD sources with one audience recording; Charlie Miller handled all transfers and mastering for the matrix mix [3]
- **gd1983-10-17.fob.senn421.chasingwilma.102070.flac16**: taped by chasingwilma; transferred by chasingwilma; source: Lineage: master cassette > cd > eac > flac Recording Equipment : (3) sennhesier 421 fob> tcm d-5> cm> cd Recording Location: fob Recorded By: chasingwilma [2]
- **gd83-10-17.sbd.miller.27585.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: flac16 mixed SBD sources, plus AUD patches: Set 1: SBD> Master Cassette> Dat> Sonic Solutions> CD> EAC> FLAC; Set 2: SBD> Master Cassette> Reel> Dat> CD> EAC>… [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Olympic Center - October 17, 1983](https://www.dead.net/show/october-17-1983) [40]
